name: shoptegrity
description: See who owns what you buy, find independent and local sellers, and check sale prices against recorded price history. Every fact is cited or withheld.

interface.longDescription:
Shoptegrity helps you shop with integrity. Ask about a brand, a store, or a whole shopping list and see who owns it and where the money goes, with a linked source for every fact, or a plain "withheld" when there isn't one.

What you can do:
- Find independent sellers for a product or gift, within your budget
- Check a sale price against the prices Shoptegrity has recorded daily, and see when a price was raised before the "discount"
- See price drops on products Shoptegrity tracks
- Check a cart or gift list to learn which company is behind each item, using SEC filings where they exist
- Find local businesses, co-ops, farmers markets and credit unions near a ZIP code or town, where Shoptegrity has listings
- Browse employee-owned, cooperative, credit-union, B Corp and family-owned alternatives, each with its source
- Get a plan for Black Friday, Small Business Saturday, Cyber Monday, Giving Tuesday and holiday gifts

Results are never ordered by commission. Grades and ratings are Shoptegrity's opinion under a published methodology. No account is needed, and the tools only need a brand, product or place name.
defaultPrompt: Help me shop Black Friday with integrity. My list: cast iron skillet, wooden toys, board game. Budget $250.
Check my cart: The North Face jacket, Tide pods, a Walmart gift card. Also show cited alternatives for The North Face.
Find merino wool socks under $25 from independent sellers and check whether the prices are real deals.

positive.description: Plan a Black Friday shop with independent sellers and price history checks
positive.prompt: Help me shop Black Friday with integrity. My list: cast iron skillet, wooden toys, board game. Budget $250.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the Black Friday date and steps, checks each list item, and lists independent sellers for cast iron skillets, wooden toys and board games with price, seller name and 11-day recorded price-history verdicts (such as lowest_recorded, below_usual and usual_price). No result is ordered by commission.

positive.description: Check a cart for ownership and find cited alternatives
positive.prompt: Check my cart: The North Face jacket, Tide pods, a Walmart gift card. Also show approved alternatives for The North Face and employee-owned grocery options.
positive.expected_behavior: The North Face matches V. F. Corporation and Tide matches The Procter & Gamble Company with SEC Form 10-K links; Walmart returns SEC-sourced revenue, net income and shareholder payout. find_alternatives returns Patagonia, Cotopaxi and REI Co-op with cited sources, and browse_alternatives returns WinCo Foods, Publix, Hy-Vee and Weaver Street Market.

positive.description: Find independent sellers within a budget
positive.prompt: Find merino wool socks under $25 from independent sellers.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns independent sellers' merino socks at $25 or less with price, seller name, product link and a price check. Sellers without a Shoptegrity record say so plainly.

positive.description: Look for verified price drops and flag raised-then-lowered prices
positive.prompt: Show verified price drops right now, verify the top deal with check_deal, and check 3-wick candles under $30 for prices that were raised before a discount.
positive.expected_behavior: verified_deals lists products with 10+ days of recorded price history whose price dropped below their usual price (such as Ransom Notes word game, Boden merino sweater, Bare Home organic cotton sheets, and Our Place Cast Iron Always Pan). check_deal confirms the lowest_recorded verdict and usual price, and responsible_alternatives on 3-wick candles flags raised_then_lowered prices where $13.99 was briefly raised to $25.50.

positive.prompt: Find local co-ops and farmers markets near Minneapolis, MN.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns nearby co-ops, farmers markets, CSAs and credit unions with address and distance, plus independent local shops. Ownership details read as withheld until a cited record exists.

negative.description: Asked to buy something; Shoptegrity cannot purchase or pay
negative.prompt: Buy the cheapest wool blanket you find and charge my card.

negative.description: Asked to rate a company Shoptegrity has no record of; it must not invent a grade
negative.prompt: Give me an integrity grade for a small local shop called Birchwood Home Goods.

negative.description: Asked for investment advice; outside scope
negative.prompt: Based on shareholder payouts, which of these retailers' stocks should I buy?

review.commerce_description: Shoptegrity does not sell anything or process payments. It returns links to sellers' own product pages and retailers' own deal pages; any purchase happens on the seller's site.
